Parent.description: A parent or carer on the PTA. A first name alone is not an identity.

Fundraiser.description: A PTA fundraising event, known by its name.

Link.description: A standing arrangement between two parents: one stands in as the other's deputy, or one gives the other lifts.

Role.description:
The role a parent signs up for on a fundraiser: organiser, treasurer or volunteer.
Attending an event is not a role.

Donation.description: A gift offered to the PTA. pledged_by offered it, collected_by picks it up, approved_by accepts it for the committee. A hope of a gift is not a pledge.

RotaSlot.description: A duty on a fundraiser's rota. assigned does the duty, cover takes over if needed. confirmed stays empty until someone confirms it.

questions.q: Who is the treasurer for Quiz Night?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fundraiser)-[:treasurer]->(n1:Parent) WHERE n0.name = 'Quiz Night' RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Fundraiser)-[:organiser]->(n1:Parent) WHERE n0.name = 'Fun Run' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: fatou
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parent)-[:deputy]->(n1:Parent) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: desmond
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parent)-[:passenger]->(n1:Parent) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: margarethe
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parent)-[:helping]->(n1:Fundraiser) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who volunteers at the Book Swap?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fundraiser)-[:volunteer]->(n1:Parent) WHERE n0.name = 'Book Swap' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Is the cash gift gift aided?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Donation) WHERE n0.item = 'cash gift' RETURN n0.gift_aided AS gift_aided

questions.q: Is there a record that the voucher is gift aided?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Donation) WHERE n0.item = 'voucher' RETURN coalesce(n0.gift_aided, false) AS gift_aided
MATCH (n0:Donation)-[:approved_by]->(n1:Parent) WHERE n0.item = 'voucher' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Which donations did Fatou Sow pledge?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Parent)<-[:pledged_by]-(n1:Donation) WHERE n0.name = 'Fatou Sow' RETURN n1.item AS item

questions.q: How much were the board games worth?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Donation) WHERE n0.item = 'board games' RETURN n0.value_pounds AS value_pounds

questions.q: What duties and minutes are on the Spring Fair rota?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fundraiser)<-[:fundraiser]-(n1:RotaSlot) WHERE n0.name = 'Spring Fair' RETURN n1.duty AS duty, n1.minutes AS minutes

questions.q: How long are the slot duties?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:RotaSlot) WHERE n0.duty CONTAINS 'slot' RETURN n0.minutes AS minutes
MATCH (n0:RotaSlot) WHERE n0.duty = 'bar slot' RETURN n0.confirmed AS confirmed

questions.q: Is there a record that the tombola is confirmed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:RotaSlot) WHERE n0.duty = 'tombola' RETURN coalesce(n0.confirmed, false) AS confirmed
MATCH (n0:RotaSlot)-[:cover]->(n1:Parent) WHERE n0.duty = 'raffle slot' RETURN n1.name AS name
